raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do?

Refresh the 26.10 Qwen3 235B A22B benchmark on 256 DGX-GB300 GPUs with MXFP8 using the successful retry's results.

# Changelog

- Update Tokens / sec / GPU from 8,496 to 9,152.
- Update Model TFLOP / sec / GPU from 1,259 to 1,355 (measured 1354.94, rounded to the existing table precision).

# GitHub Actions CI

Documentation only. Local `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` and `git diff --check` passed. Values verified against the 26.10 E2E sheet row 104 and completed job 519153369. No benchmark jobs launched; commit uses `[skip ci]`.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

- [x] Read and followed contributor guidelines.
- [x] Updated necessary documentation.
- Tests: not applicable; one Markdown row changed.
- Optional components/import guards: not applicable.

# Additional Information

Follow-up to #6734. Primary area: `area:perf`.
